mapper.sql: id, agent_run_id, step_id, model_call_id, tool_definition_id, tool_version_id, tool_code, tool_version, call_key, arguments_hash, status, arguments_snapshot_ref, arguments_summary, result_snapshot_ref, result_summary, result_size_bytes, retry_of_tool_call_id, started_at, finished_at, error_code, error_summary, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tool_call ( agent_run_id, step_id, model_call_id, tool_definition_id, tool_version_id, tool_code, tool_version, call_key, arguments_hash, status, arguments_snapshot_ref, arguments_summary, result_snapshot_ref, result_summary, result_size_bytes, retry_of_tool_call_id, started_at, finished_at, error_code, error_summary, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{agentRunId}, #{stepId}, #{modelCallId}, #{toolDefinitionId}, #{toolVersionId}, #{toolCode}, #{toolVersion}, #{callKey}, #{argumentsHash}, #{status}, #{argumentsSnapshotRef}, #{argumentsSummary}, #{resultSnapshotRef}, #{resultSummary}, #{resultSizeBytes}, #{retryOfToolCallId}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{errorCode}, #{errorSummary}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tool_call SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', result_snapshot_ref = #{resultSnapshotRef}, result_summary = #{resultSummary}, result_size_bytes = #{resultSizeBytes}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE tool_call SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_summary = #{errorSummary}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')

UPDATE tool_call SET status = 'CANCELLED', error_code = 'CANCELLED', error_summary = '工具调用已取消', finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
